title: Polish Mole Fondue
description: A rich, creamy twist on traditional Mexican mole sauce served as a fondue for dipping breads.
instructions: Heat the fondue in a saucepan over medium heat.
Add the Polish sugars, velvety, chili powder, cumin, cayenne pepper, and garlic powder to the fondue. Stir until dissolved.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning with salt as needed.
Serve the fondue in a fondue pot or a small saucepan.
Cut the bread into cubes and serve for dipping.
Cook the bread in the fondue for 1-2 minutes on each side, until crispy and golden brown.
